title: Senior Dynamics GP Administrator
description:
Job Title:- Senior Dynamics GP Administrator

Experience:- 5+Years

Location :- Remote/Hybrid (Canada/Mexico/US/Brazil)


Role summary

Seeking a Senior Dynamics GP Administrator to own day-to-day operations of Microsoft Dynamics GP and related integrations, support ongoing configuration and customization, and partner with stakeholders on planning and executing an upgrade/migration to Dynamics 365 Business Central. This is a hands-on production support role with accountability for stability, performance, change control, and documentation.


Key responsibilities

Daily Operations & Support

  • Administer and support Dynamics GP environments (production and non-prod): user/security management, company setups, batch processing, month-end close support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
  • Monitor system health and performance; coordinate with infrastructure/DBA teams on backups, restores, refreshes, and disaster recovery readiness.
  • Manage support tickets, root-cause analysis, and preventive fixes; communicate status to business and IT stakeholders.


Configuration & Customizations

  • Maintain and support GP configuration (financials, purchasing, inventory, etc., as applicable) including setups, posting processes, and workflows.
  • Support and coordinate customizations (modified forms/reports, SSRS, SmartLists, VBA/Dexterity add-ons, third-party ISVs), including testing and deployment across environments.
  • Maintain change control: release notes, regression testing, and documentation of functional and technical changes.


Integrations & Data

  • Own operational support for integrations into/out of GP (eConnect, SSIS, SmartConnect/Scribe/other middleware, file-based imports/exports, API/EDI as applicable).
  • Troubleshoot integration failures, reconcile data issues, and coordinate enhancements with developers and vendors.


Business Central Upgrade / Migration Assistance

  • Support discovery and readiness activities for GP → Dynamics 365 Business Central migration: inventory configuration/customizations, integration mapping, data migration scoping, and cutover planning support.
  • Assist with UAT coordination, defect triage, and transition planning (process changes, training inputs, documentation updates).


Documentation

  • Produce and maintain operational runbooks and environment documentation (security, integrations, job schedules, close procedures, troubleshooting guides).
  • Create a customization and integration register to support modernization and migration planning.


Required qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on Dynamics GP administration/support in production environments.
  • Strong knowledge of GP security, posting/batch processes, and month-end close support.
  • Experience supporting GP customizations and reporting (modified forms/reports, SSRS/SmartList Builder, third-party add-ons).
  • Integration support experience (eConnect and/or middleware such as SmartConnect, Scribe, SSIS; troubleshooting data movement and reconciliation).
  • Solid SQL Server skills (reading/writing queries for troubleshooting, understanding GP databases, jobs, and performance basics).
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills; comfortable working in a ticketed support model.


Preferred qualifications

  • Prior involvement in GP → Business Central migration/upgrade projects (discovery, fit-gap, testing, cutover).

title: Analytics Architect
description:
Analytics Architect

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks/ Fabric. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of big data technologies, data engineering, and cloud computing, with a strong focus on Azure Databricks along with Strong SQL.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders and other IT teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
  • Oversee the end-to-end implementation of data solutions, ensuring alignment with business requirements and best practices.
  • Lead the development of data pipelines and ETL processes using Azure Databricks, PySpark, and other relevant tools.
  • Integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services (e.g., Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory) and on-premise systems .
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the data engineering team, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Ensure proper documentation of architecture, processes, and data flows, while ensuring compliance with security and governance standards.
  • Ensure best practices are followed in terms of code quality, data security, and scalability.
  • Stay updated with the latest developments in Databricks and associated technologies to drive innovation.

Essential Skills:

  • Strong experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake.
  • Proficiency in big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) and data processing frameworks (e.g., PySpark).
  • Deep understanding of Azure services like Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory. Power BI, SSRS, SSAS, PSKU to F SKU.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing, and building data lakes.
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems like Git.
  • Knowledge of cloud security best practices.

Soft Skills:

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
  • Leadership skills with the ability to manage and mentor a team of data engineers.

Nice to have Skills:

  • Power BI for dashboarding and reporting.
  • Microsoft Fabric for analytics and integration tasks.
  • Spark Streaming for processing real-time data streams.
  • Familiarity with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates for infrastructure as code (IaC) practices.

title: Global Process Data Consultant | SAP S/4HANA | OTC & MTO | Data Migration & Governance
description:
Position Purpose

undertaking multiple large-scale global transformation initiatives , including a greenfield SAP S/4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC, MTO).

We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Consultant/Lead to support data conversion, migration, governance, and ongoing data management . This role is critical in ensuring business data is fit-for-purpose, standardized, governed, and ready to enable successful process design, system build, migration, and user adoption.

The consultant will act as a bridge between business process owners, SAP functional teams, and the data enablement organization , embedding data requirements into solution design and execution.

Key Responsibilities

1. Data Enablement & Solution Design

  • Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements aligned with standardized value stream processes
  • Translate business process designs into clear master and transactional data definitions for SAP S/4HANA
  • Support global template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and hierarchies across geographies
  • Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return)

2. Functional Process Data Ownership

  • Define data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields
  • Support business rules, validations, and derivations
  • Align data structures with SAP best practices and industry standards

3. Data Migration & Readiness

  • Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities
  • Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to SAP S/4HANA
  • Participate in mock conversions, data loads, and reconciliation cycles
  • Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover

4. Data Governance & Standards

  • Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies
  • Collaborate closely with Master Data Management and Data Governance teams
  • Help define data ownership, stewardship, and governance models
  • Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes

5. Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

  • Support functional and integrated testing with a strong focus on data accuracy and completeness
  • Validate business scenarios using migrated and newly created data
  • Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization during hypercare

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 5+ years of SAP functional experience with a strong focus on data
  • Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield preferred)
  • Proven involvement in large-scale, global ERP implementations
  • Strong understanding of value stream business processes and related data objects
  • Experience supporting data migration, cleansing, and validation

Technical & Functional Skills

  • Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects, including:
  • Material Master
  • Customer / Business Partner
  • Vendor
  • BOMs
  • Routings
  • Pricing
  • Understanding of S/4HANA data model changes vs. ECC
  • Experience with SAP MDG or similar data governance tools (preferred)
  • Familiarity with data migration tools such as SAP Migration Cockpit, LVM, or ETL tools
  • Ability to interpret functional specifications and data models

Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Ability to work across global, cross-functional teams
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced transformation environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset-intensive industries
  • Prior experience as a Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead
  • Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models
  • Knowledge of data quality tools and metrics

title: Especialista em PMO | Implantação de Escritórios de Projetos com PPM + IA
description:
Empresas não falham por falta de esforço.


Falham quando crescem mais rápido do que sua capacidade de organizar, governar e executar projetos .

É nesse ponto que esta posição atua.


Estamos buscando um(a) Especialista em PMO para atuar na organização e implantação de Escritórios de Projetos (PMO) em empresas de médio e grande porte, utilizando uma plataforma PPM robusta, consolidada no mercado e utilizada por grandes organizações nacionais .


Você irá trabalhar com o NetProject PPM , uma solução madura de gestão de portfólios, programas e projetos , que agora evolui incorporando Inteligência Artificial aplicada à gestão , desenvolvida a partir de parcerias com institutos de pesquisa no Brasil e na Itália .


O desafio do papel


Na prática, você será responsável por:

  • Estruturar e implantar PMOs e modelos de governança adequados ao nível de maturidade de cada organização
  • Apoiar clientes na definição de processos, rituais, indicadores e estruturas de portfólio
  • Conduzir a adoção do NetProject PPM como sistema central de gestão de projetos e portfólios
  • Aplicar recursos de IA e LLMs para apoiar:
  • Estruturação de planejamentos
  • Análise e priorização de portfólios
  • Apoio à tomada de decisão executiva
  • Melhoria da previsibilidade e da execução
  • Atuar como referência técnica em gestão estruturada , conectando método, dados e tecnologia


Este não é um papel operacional.

É um papel de arquitetura de sistemas de execução .



Pré-requisitos


Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Experiência comprovada na implantação ou evolução de PMOs
  • Vivência prática em gestão de portfólios, programas e projetos
  • Visão sistêmica de governança, indicadores e maturidade organizacional
  • Conhecimento ou experiência no uso de Inteligência Artificial aplicada à gestão
  • LLMs
  • Apoio automatizado ao planejamento
  • Análise inteligente de dados de projetos
  • Capacidade de dialogar com times técnicos e com executivos


Diferenciais


Serão considerados diferenciais:

  • Certificações em gestão de projetos (PMI, IPMA, PRINCE2, etc.)
  • Experiência com ferramentas PPM em ambientes corporativos
  • Vivência em projetos de transformação organizacional
  • Interesse em pesquisa aplicada, inovação e evolução de modelos de gestão


Por que a NetProject?


Porque o NetProject não é uma ferramenta experimental.

  • É uma plataforma PPM consolidada , utilizada por grandes empresas nacionais
  • Foi construída a partir de problemas reais de governança e execução
  • Evolui agora com IA aplicada , baseada em pesquisa científica e parcerias acadêmicas no Brasil e na Itália
  • Tem como foco transformar crescimento desorganizado em execução estruturada


Aqui, a tecnologia não substitui método.

Ela potencializa decisões, previsibilidade e governança .

title: Analista de Infraestrutura de Servidores
description:
Buscamos um Analista de Infraestrutura para sustentar servidores e serviços críticos e fortalecer a segurança em endpoints em ambientes como hospitais, governo, indústria e varejo.

Responsabilidades:

  • Administrar servidores físicos e virtuais (Windows Server e, desejável, Linux).
  • Gerenciar serviços de infraestrutura: AD, DNS, DHCP, File Server, GPOs e permissões de acesso.
  • Atuar em patching e hardening de servidores e estações.
  • Acompanhar saúde do ambiente via ferramentas de monitoramento;
  • Apoiar rotinas e testes de backup e recuperação.
  • Operar e apoiar soluções de Endpoint Security (antivírus/EDR) em servidores e endpoints.
  • Documentar mudanças, padrões e procedimentos de forma organizada.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência prática com administração de Windows Server (instalação, configuração, troubleshooting).
  • Conhecimentos em virtualização (VMware, Hyper-V ou similares).
  • Noção de redes (TCP/IP, VLAN, conceitos básicos de firewall).
  • Ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix ou similares);
  • Experiência com soluções de backup (local e/ou nuvem).
  • Vivência com Endpoint Protection / EDR corporativo.
  • Desejável: Experiência com ambientes de missão crítica;
  • Diferencial: Certificação de Cloud Azure e AWS;

Perfil comportamental

  • Postura de aliado em cibersegurança: pensa junto com o cliente, não apenas "entrega ticket".
  • Mentalidade de dono do ambiente: trata a infraestrutura do cliente como se fosse sua.
  • Visão prática de risco: sabe priorizar o que realmente importa.
  • Organização para lidar com múltiplos clientes e atividades simultâneas.
  • Vontade de aprender continuamente e evoluir junto com o time.

Benefícios:

  • Vale Transporte (VT)
  • Vale Refeição (VR)
  • Vale Cultura
  • Bolsa Atleta X
  • Plano de desenvolvimento de carreira
  • Incentivo à certificações

Ambiente de trabalho:

  • Plano de Carreira
  • Ambiente saudável, colaborativo e com espaço real para crescimento.
  • Empresa certificada GPTW pelo 3o ano consecutivo, com cultura de parceria e proximidade entre liderança e time.
  • Contato diário com tecnologias de cibersegurança e infraestrutura em ambientes desafiadores e de alta criticidade.

title: Analista de compras
description:
O que irá fazer:

  • Realizar cotações e compras de materiais, insumos e serviços, assegurando as melhores condições comerciais;
  • Negociar com fornecedores visando redução de custos, melhores prazos de pagamento e entrega, e qualidade dos produtos;
  • Emitir pedidos de compra e autorizações de fornecimento, garantindo as aprovações internas necessárias;

  • Prospectar novos fornecedores e produtos, buscando inovação e melhoria contínua;

  • Garantir o cumprimento da legislação aplicável, normas de Saúde, Segurança do Trabalho e Meio Ambiente;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de melhoria contínua e compliance da cadeia logística.

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia, Administração, Logística ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima na função ou em atividades similares;

  • Vivência obrigatória com sistemas SAP MM e S/4 HANA (ERP);

title: Técnico de Campo - Telecomunicações/TI
description:
A Teltronic é referência global em soluções de comunicação crítica, oferecendo sistemas de rádio, redes de dados e centros de controle para setores essenciais como segurança pública, transporte e energia. Com presença em mais de 60 países, buscamos profissionais comprometidos com a excelência e inovação.

Responsabilidades

  • Instalar, configurar, testar e realizar manutenção de sistemas de comunicação sem fio.
  • Prestar suporte técnico durante a execução de projetos.
  • Elaborar planos de ação, realizar levantamentos e estudos técnicos.
  • Gerenciar redes e solucionar requisições, incidentes e mudanças.
  • Produzir relatórios técnicos detalhados.

Requisitos

  • Formação técnica em Telecomunicações ou graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Computação, Engenharia de Telecomunicações ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimentos em administração de bancos de dados, virtualização de servidores e sistemas operacionais Linux e Windows.
  • Experiência em configuração e gerenciamento de equipamentos de rede (roteadores, switches).
  • Certificações como CCNA ou Mikrotik são diferenciais.
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de comunicação (TCP/IP, ISO/OSI, XML) e sistemas de comunicação sem fio.
  • Experiência com sistemas de CFTV, videomonitoramento e redes de comunicação (Micro-ondas, PDH, SDH, Fibra Ótica).
  • Habilidade na manutenção de sistemas de telecomunicações, software, redes de dados e telefonia.
  • Proficiência em pacote Office

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com sistema Tetra e centros de controle.
  • Certificações adicionais em administração de redes.

description:

description:
Local: Salvador – BA - (AL + BA Metropolitana + SE)

Missão

Garantir a execução da estratégia comercial no campo por meio de treinamentos, consultorias e desenvolvimento de líderes regionais. Foco em aumentar produtividade, qualidade de rota e rentabilidade das operações, conectando método, comportamento e resultado.

  • Participação em projetos de melhoria contínua, incluindo PDCA, cronoanálises, benchmarking, testes de produtividade e pilotos em campo.

Diferenciais

  • Forte atuação em execução comercial, treinamento e inteligência de campo.
  • Conhecimento aplicado em PDCA, DMAIC, Lean, feedback estruturado e gestão por dados.

  • Perfil com influência lateral, escuta ativa, comunicação clara e pensamento de dono.

title: Agenciador de Imóveis
description:
Oportunidade Confidencial – Parceiro Comercial em Captação de Imóveis

Estamos em busca de pessoas que queiram crescer junto com um projeto inovador no setor imobiliário. Se você tem energia comercial, gosta de desafios e sabe transformar conversas em oportunidades, essa vaga pode ser para você.

Nosso time de parceiros comerciais atua diretamente na promoção da nossa marca, buscando também trazer proprietários de imóveis para locação para dentro da nossa plataforma.   • Acompanhar o processo de captação até a ativação do imóvel na plataforma;
  • Trabalhar com metas mensais de captação e indicadores de performance;
  • Contornar objeções e conduzir negociações com segurança, empatia e foco no fechamento.

O que buscamos

  • Perfil comercial, resiliente e com alta capacidade de autogerenciamento;
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e habilidade em negociação;
  • Disposição para abordagem ativa (ligações, mensagens e contato direto com proprietários);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas digitais e sistemas de CRM;
  • Experiência anterior com captação de imóveis ou atendimento ao cliente é um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento do mercado imobiliário local também é valorizado.

O que oferecemos

  • Contrato como Pessoa Jurídica (PJ);
  • Ajuda de custo mensal e bonificações por desempenho;
  • Modelo de trabalho com autonomia e flexibilidade de jornada;
  • Não exigimos CRECI nem veículo próprio;
  • Suporte estruturado com Jornada de Conhecimento, ferramentas e acompanhamento contínuo;
  • Acesso a um projeto nacional em expansão, com possibilidade real de crescimento.

Nosso compromisso

Aqui, valorizamos quem entrega resultado. Você terá espaço para atuar com autonomia, apoio para evoluir e reconhecimento proporcional ao seu desempenho. Se você busca desafios e quer fazer parte da transformação do mercado imobiliário, essa pode ser a sua próxima oportunidade.

title: Databricks QA
description:
• Experience: 5-8 Years

    • Key Requirements:

    • The resource should have a strong background in working with cloud platforms, APIs, and data processing. Experienced in AWS Glue, Athena, and Databricks.
    • AWS Glue Jobs: The QE should have familiarity with AWS Glue jobs for ETL processes. We expect them to validate the successful execution of around Glue jobs, ensuring that transformations and data ingestion tasks are working smoothly without errors.
    • Athena Querying: Experience with querying data using AWS Athena is a must, as the QE will be required to validate queries across multiple datasets. We expect the resource to run and validate Athena queries for data accuracy and integrity.
    • Databricks Testing: The candidate should have experience with Databricks, particularly in validating data pipelines and transformations within the Databricks environment. The QE will need to test Databricks notebooks or jobs, ensuring data accuracy in the bronze, silver, and gold layers.
    • The resource should also have good knowledge on Boomi or any other integration tool like MuleSoft, Informatica, Talend, Workato, etc.

title: Executivo (a) Comercial Externo
description:
Executivo(a) Comercial | Transforme o Setor de Energia com a Gente!

Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil

Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.

A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.

Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui

Sua Missão: Ser a Ponte Para um Futuro Energético Mais Justo

Como Executivo(a) Comercial, você será a cara da Liora para nossos clientes, sendo peça-chave para estruturar e escalar nossos canais de vendas. Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor.

Você será a peça-chave para:

  • Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética.
  • Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza.
  • Construir relações de confiança que duram.

Principais Responsabilidades:

️Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante.

Desenvolver Parcerias Estratégicas: Mapear, negociar e ativar redes de parceiros que nos ajudem a multiplicar nosso alcance e impacto.

Realizar Vendas Consultivas: Entender profundamente as dores e necessidades dos clientes para apresentar a solução da Liora de forma personalizada e irresistível.

Conduzir o Ciclo de Vendas Completo: Apresentar propostas de valor, negociar com clareza e fechar contratos que gerem valor real para os clientes e para a Liora.

Atuar como a Voz do Cliente: Trazer feedbacks valiosos do mercado para colaborar com os times de Produto, Marketing e Pós-venda, nos ajudando a melhorar continuamente.

O que Buscamos em Você:

  • Perfil Hunter: Você tem energia, resiliência e paixão por abrir novas portas e prospectar clientes.
  • Comunicação Excepcional: Habilidade de se comunicar de forma clara, direta e empática, criando conexões genuínas.
  • Foco no Cliente: Uma obsessão por entender, resolver problemas e encantar quem está do outro lado da linha.
  • Mentalidade de Dono(a): Autonomia para planejar, agilidade para executar e flexibilidade para ajustar a rota em busca dos melhores resultados.
  • Ambição Gigante: O desejo de não apenas bater metas, mas de construir a maior e mais confiável provedora de serviços de energia do Brasil

Nossa Proposta de Valor:

Remuneração Sem Teto: Salário fixo competitivo + comissionamento agressivo e sem limites. Aqui, seu resultado define seu ganho.

Plano de Saúde: Subsidiado pela empresa.

Seguro de Vida.

️Vale-Refeição/Alimentação.

Vale-Transporte ou Auxílio Deslocamento.

E aí, vamos transformar o futuro da energia juntos?

title: Platform Engineer (AWS)
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You're looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.

You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 4+ years of experience as a Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or Infrastructure Engineer with focus on developer enablement.
  • Deep expertise in AWS, especially working with services like ECS, IAM, and supporting microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, and CI/CD pipeline orchestration in production environments.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or configuration formats like YAML and JSON for automation.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms, ideally using frameworks like Backstage.
  • Strong understanding of Platform as a Service (PaaS) principles and creating self-service tools to streamline developer workflows.
  • Experience developing modular, reusable infrastructure templates to enable scalable and consistent resource provisioning.
  • Familiarity with automatic provisioning logic, such as conditional resource deployment based on developer inputs.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills; fluent in English (advanced).

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Build and evolve the internal developer platform, enabling engineering teams to self-serve infrastructure and deployments efficiently.
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, ensuring secure, automated delivery across services.
  • Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code modules that enforce best practices and support multi-service deployments at scale.
  • Create reusable infrastructure templates for provisioning environments like ECS, based on dynamic developer inputs.
  • Automate resource provisioning workflows, including conditional logic and default resource allocation.
  • Develop self-service tools and dashboards that reduce support tickets and empower development teams.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the platform by continuously implementing updates and integrating new cloud-native technologies.
  • Collaborate with security and compliance teams to integrate guardrails and standards into platform tooling.
  • Support internal adoption of Backstage or similar developer portal frameworks to centralize resources and documentation.
  • Drive initiatives to reduce manual operations and increase developer velocity through automation and platform reliability.

Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*

*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Senior backend (typescript) engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!Yes, tell me more…
fullinfo is a startup B2 B data services software company.
We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.
The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and Graph QL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.We’re looking for aSenior Backend (Typescript) Engineerto join on an initial 12-month B2 B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.Responsibilities:
You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
Optimising the product for continuous scalability
Delivering ongoing process improvement
Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
Meet aggressive development timelines.
Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.Requirements:
A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
Business Proficiency in English is essential
Meticulous attention to detail.
Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.The successful candidate will…
Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.What can you expect from us?
To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
Together we’ll take our product to market –how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:
Quality :At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.
Problem Solving :We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Software engineer sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos
Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:
Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações webutilizandoJava Script/Type Scripte frameworks modernos comoReact e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance.
Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dadoscom bancos relacionais e não relacionais(Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, comoAzure, GCP e AWS.
Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.
Definir arquitetura de softwaree padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas deDev Ops, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
Mentorar desenvolvedoresde diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
Contribuir estrategicamentepara decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.O que nós estamos procurando;Formação:Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.
Experiência solida (+5 anos):em desenvolvimento web comReact, Next.js, Java Script e Type Script.
Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e No SQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
Experiência prática com Dev Ops e CI/CD , uso deDocker ,Kubernetese ferramentas de integração contínua.
Visão arquiteturale capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.
Inglês fluente(para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).O que oferecemos;
VR/VT
Free office(trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass
Seguros:Vida, saúde e odontológico
Encontros Bimestrais(Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)
Woba(pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
Avaliações semestrais(com oportunidade de promoção)Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;
Artefacté o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados
Progresso:cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender
Cultura:junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar
Empreendedorismo:você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!
Junte-se a nós!

title: College-level chemistry tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. title: Devops engineer
description:
Important Information
Location:Brazil
Job Mode:Full-time
Work Mode:Work from homeJob Summary
As a Dev Ops Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The Dev Ops engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teamsResponsibilities and Duties
Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;
Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Git Hub Actions;
Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.Essential Skills
Experience in a Dev Ops role, with hands-on AWS experience;
Experience with Ia C tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
Familiarity with CI/CD tools like Circle CI and Github Actions;
Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills;
Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).Highly Desirable Skills
Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, Cloud Watch;
Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
AWS Certified Dev Ops Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.About EncoraEncora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, Dev Sec Ops, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Sap advanced business application programming consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking for " SAP ABAP" Remote in Brazilwho wants to learn and transform his career.In this role you will: (responsibilities)Prototype, design, develop, and maintain Mobile Application Integration Framework and its integration services to support mobile applications such as SAP Service and Asset Manager, SAP Maintenance Assistant, as well as other system-to-system integration scenarios such as S/4 HANA and Asset Performance Management solution integration, S/4 HANA Disconnected Defense, S/4 HANA Last Mile Delivery, S/4 HANA and Business Network Asset Collaboration solution integration etc.
Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of SAP ABAP programming model and development tools in development and testing, such as ABAP OO, ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model, BAPI, BAd I, Open SQL, RDBMS, SAPGUI, ABAP Development Tools for Eclipse, Web Dynpro for ABAP, Fiori Elements, SAP Gateway, OData Service, S/4 HANA Private Cloud, S/4 HAN Public Cloud, SAP ERP system etc.
Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, integration feature requirement
Setup and configure necessary S/4 HANA system business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), setup necessary test data (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), to support the development and test of integration services.
Collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines when relevant.
Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features
Actively collaborate with frontend MDK developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend.
Conduct thorough testing, including ABAP unit test to fulfill code coverage requirement, backward compatibility, and prevent performance and feature regression with any new development and enhancement.
Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, short dumps, and performance issues
Provide sufficient documentations on features developed
Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation
Follow agile development principles and best practice during development
Participate in daily scrums
Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates
Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from Service Now. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in Servicew Now incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.
Maintain communication and documentation in English
Maintain proper communication and notification with lead ABAP developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline
What can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

title: Anti-money laundering manager
description:
About Us
Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.Key Responsibilities:
Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings withCOAFor relevant authorities.
Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.Requirements:
Legally resident in Brazil.
Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Sales manager -  nutraceutical ingredients ( latam)
description:
Sales Manager - Nutraceutical Ingredients ( LATAM)Location: Brazil (Remote)Territory: Latin AmericaAbout the RoleWe’re seeking a Sales Manager to drive growth across LATAM. You will sell nutraceutical ingredients to the dietary supplement and functional food & beverage industries, building a high-quality pipeline and long-term customer relationships.Responsibilities
• Manage and grow key accounts across LATAM, fostering senior-level relationships with brand owners, CDMOs/contract manufacturers, and distributors.
• Develop and execute country- and segment-level territory plans to capture new business.
• Present nutraceutical ingredients to customers, clearly articulating benefits, applications, and go-to-market plans.
• Collaborate with technical, regulatory, and marketing teams to deliver tailored solutions and product launches.
• Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify white space and protect share.
• Meet and exceed quarterly/annual sales targets with accurate forecasting and disciplined CRM hygiene.
• Represent the company at regional trade shows, conferences, and industry events.
• Provide technical/product support to customers in coordination with internal teams.
• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regional regulations and standards (e.g., ANVISA, COFEPRIS, INVIMA).Requirements
• 5+ years of B2 B sales experience in nutraceutical ingredients within LATAM.
• Strong understanding of nutraceutical ingredients and their applications in dietary supplements and functional F&B.
• Proven ability to prospect, build pipelines, negotiate, and close across multiple countries.
• Language: Fluent Portuguese and strong Spanish; English is a plus.
• Self-starter comfortable working remotely; excellent territory/time management.
• Based in Brazil with willingness to travel across LATAM as required.
• Proficiency with MS Office and CRM (ZOHO preferred).

At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

title: Sap basis consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking forSAP Basis Consultantwho wants to learn and transform his career.In this role you will: (responsibilities)Technical
Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis and SAP Applications
Hands-on experience with SAP Basis activities, SAP release version upgrades and infrastructure updates for cloud customers
Working experience with SAP HEC, SAP S/4 HANA or any other cloud solution.
Hands-on experience with infrastructure operations, network, interfaces and Load Balancer topics related to SAP landscape management (TLO)
Strong technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to form the solution/designing the mechanism for end to end solutioning
Hands on experience in Migration (onpremise to Cloud/Cross cloud/Cross DC's)Soft Skills
Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results-driven / Self-organized / Decision making
Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
Understanding of escalation handling and procedures with customers while proactively working with internal teams towards arriving at a resolution
Experience in working with cross-cultural and cross-functional teams or individuals
Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)Good to have
Cloud architecture and IT technical infrastructure know-how
Knowledge of/certification in one of Azure, AWS or GCP fundamentals
Experience with Migration, Upgrade projects esp. on S/4 H Cloud
Knowledge of Project Management Fundamentals, ITIL, Lean Fundamentals is a plusWhat can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
• Opportunities to work outside Brazil
• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.What do we offer?TCS Benefits – Brazil:
Health insurance
Dental Plan
Life insurance
Transportation vouchers
Meal/Food Voucher
Childcare assistance
Gympass
TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
Partnership with SESC
Reimbursement of Certifications
Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
International experience opportunity
Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career PlatformAt TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!#BuildingonbeliefID:

title: Pessoa engenheira de dados  - vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.
Quem somos:
Nós da Artefact Lat Am acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!
Quais serão suas responsabilidades:
Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.
Inovar. Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
Aprender e Compartilhar.Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
Desenvolver.Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
Atuarem toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
Popularizartermos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
Priorizarsuas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.
O que estamos procurando:Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações
O que oferecemos:VR/VT
Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass
Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)
Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.
Quem somos:
Nós da Artefact Lat Am acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!
Quais serão suas responsabilidades:
Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.
Inovar. Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
Aprender e Compartilhar.Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
Desenvolver.Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
Atuarem toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
Popularizartermos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
Priorizarsuas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.
O que estamos procurando:Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações
O que oferecemos:VR/VT
Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass
Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)
Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

title: Api engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking forAPI Designer/Engineerwho wants to learn and transform his career.In this role you will: (responsibilities)Overview
The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.Key Responsibilities
API Design & Development
Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage Open API (Swagger), RAML, or Async API specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API Dev Ops framework.
Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.API Consumer Onboarding
Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/Open ID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.Testing & Validation
Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.Skills and Expertise
API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using Open API, Swagger Hub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, Open ID Connect, and API key management best practices.
Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman toolWhat can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
• Opportunities to work outside Brazil
• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.What do we offer?TCS Benefits – Brazil:
Health insurance
Dental Plan
Life insurance
Transportation vouchers
Meal/Food Voucher
Childcare assistance

title: Especialista em desenvolvimento de software (iot & event streaming) | remoto
description:
Sobre a Localiza | Mobi7
A Mobi7 é a unidade de soluções de telemetria e Io Tda Localiza, líder em mobilidade na América Latina. Nossa missão é transformar dados em inteligência para veículos conectados, com tecnologia de ponta e alta performance.Estamos buscando um(a) Especialista em Desenvolvimento de Softwarepara atuar no desenvolvimento demicroserviços event-drivendealta performance , processando dados em tempo real de dispositivos Io T instalados em veículos. Você fará parte de um time que constrói soluções escaláveis, resilientes e observáveis, usando uma stack moderna e práticas avançadas de engenharia.Responsabilidades e atribuições
Desenvolver microserviçosevent-drivencomJava 21+ ,Spring Boot 3.5+eSpring Cloud Stream.
Implementar pipelines destreaming de eventoscomApache Kafka(MSK), garantindoExactly-Once Semantics , DLQ e particionamento eficiente.
Criar e evoluir contratos de dados comAvroeSchema Registry.
Otimizar persistência emPostgre SQLe cache distribuído comRedis.
Garantirobservabilidade avançadacomDatadog APM , logs estruturados e métricas customizadas.
Atuar em ambienteAWS(ECS Fargate, MSK, Cloud Watch) com práticasDev Opse CI/CD.Requisitos e qualificações
Obrigatórios:
Experiência sólida atuando comJava(Spring Boot).
Domínio avançado deApache Kafka.
Experiência comAWS(ECS, Parameter Store, Cloud Watch).
Proficiência emtestes automatizados(JUnit, Testcontainers).Desejáveis:
Experiência comKotlin 2.x.
Conhecimento emDatadog APM ,Avro ,Liquibase.
Familiaridade comGraal VM Native Image.Diferenciais:
Projetos open-source.
Certificação AWS.
Experiência com Io T/telemetria veicular.BENEFÍCIOS DESSA POSIÇÃO:
Participação nos Lucros;
Carro Corporativo;
Vale Alimentação;
Vale Refeição;
Convênio Médico;
Convênio Odontológico;
Reembolso de Despesas Médicas;
Wellhub;
Previdência Privada;
Auxilio Home Office;
Allya;
Acesso ilimitado a diversos cursos da nossa Universidade Localiza;
Programas internos de treinamento e desenvolvimento;
Desconto em compra e aluguel de veículos.

title: Data scientist - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!What you will be doing:
You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.
Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)

title: Data scientist - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!What you will be doing:
You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.
Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems
What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment
What we offer:Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be:come and build the future of marketing
Progress:every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture:join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship:you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!
Come join us!

title: Principal ai engineer - ai in healthcare
description:
WHO WE AREWe are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:
Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
Automated coding and billing optimization
Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
Seamless compliance with value-based care requirementsJoin us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOUThis is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.KEY RESPONSIBILITIESVery hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!1. Build and Refine AI Products
Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy3. Own the Development Lifecycle
Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge baseREQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, Open AI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (Postgre SQL)2. Mindset & Approach
Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing3. Highly Valued Qualifications
Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, Git Hub Copilot, or similar
Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (Lang Chain, Llama Index, or similar)
Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle managementHealthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale2. Professional Excellence
Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside3. Work-Life Integration
Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainabilityREADY FOR THE CHALLENGE?If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

title: Indirect tax manager
description:
About Us:
Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.We are seeking a proactive and experiencedTax BPto support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.Job description
The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.Desired profile
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
Knowledge in Tax reform;
Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;Language:
Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.

description:
